title: TrainingPeaks TSS Goal Adherence by Workout Type
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout
| stats avg(tss) as actual count as sessions by workout_type
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/65.0,1), goal_label="65"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average training stress score with a simple target for each workout type, showing where trainingpeaks tss is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by workout type shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence workout type values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of workout type values with average training stress score and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which workout type settings help you hit your target for trainingpeaks tss and which ones fall short.
